reason: GOBOはBERT/RoBERTa/DistilBERT等を3-bit post-training quantizeし、GLUE/SQuAD、cycle-accurate DDR4 simulator、65nm synthesisのlatency/energy根拠を示す。encoder-onlyでautoregressive LLMは未評価のためtransferabilityが未解決。
title: GOBO: Quantizing Attention-Based NLP Models for Low Latency and Energy Efficient Inference
